messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INVEST-4321 - GPU_POOL_ALPHA - cuda:alloc OOM spike (12 failures in 5m) - severity: P1
pagerduty: Alert details: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INVEST-4321 - escalation policy: eng-oncall-primary
alice_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling logs and current pool state.
bob_sre: Seeing repeated "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" in pool_alpha nodes 3/5. KV cache eviction rates spiking.
carla_rte: Noted. Any customer-facing impact yet? metrics show increased latency for generation requests on model-repl-7b.
dave_ml: Yeah, 95p latency up ~1.3s for affected routes. No hard errors surfaced to users yet, just degraded throughput and some 500s for long context requests.
emma_support: We have one ticket from AcmeCorp reporting "service slow / timeouts" around the same time. Tagging it PD-4321.
alice_oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch size for model-repl-7b on pool_alpha 2) enable CPU fallback for heavy requests 3) evict largest KV cache entries 4) scale up pool_beta spare capacity
bob_sre: Doing 1) now - pushing config: ```yaml
pool: alpha
model_override:
  model-repl-7b:
    max_batch_tokens: 1024  # was 2048
    max_concurrency: 4
```
Apply confirmed on 3/5 nodes. Monitoring.
carla_rte: 2) CPU fallback toggle: `/ops toggle cpu-fallback pool_alpha` - executing.
incident-bot: Action executed: cpu-fallback enabled on pool_alpha (graceful fallback).
dave_ml: 3) K/V cache trim: increasing eviction aggressiveness by 30%. Command run on host pool-alpha-003.
bob_sre: We're seeing immediate reduction in mem pressure on host 3, but host 5 still rising. Killing a runaway worker on host 5 (pid 22411) to free GPU memory.
alice_oncall: Host 5 worker restarted; it was holding a stuck attention cache. Restart success. Memory reclaimed ~6GB.
emma_support: Notifying AcmeCorp: "We're investigating increased latency; mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m"
dave_ml: Traffic steering: routing 15% of alpha traffic -> beta to reduce load. Router rule applied.
bob_sre: New errors: "CUDA kernel launch timeout" on host 2 after the restart. Suspect fragmentation. Trying compaction: `/ops gpu-compaction host=pool-alpha-002`
carla_rte: If fragmentation persists, we should schedule rolling drain of pool_alpha and shift traffic. We have spare capacity in dedicated pool_beta.
alice_oncall: Escalating to oncall-second: @bob_sre -> @carla_rte handoff in 10m if still unstable. Posting PD note.
pagerduty: Escalation: alert PD-INVEST-4321 escalated to eng-oncall-secondary.
bob_sre: compaction command completed; memory fragmentation decreased, allocation failures stopped on host 2. Host 5 still showing elevated GC cycle counts.
dave_ml: Proposing a temporary model downgrade for heavy routes: model-repl-7b -> model-repl-3b-int8 for non-critical endpoints. Lower mem footprint, minor quality diff.
carla_rte: Approve. Patch rollout: `/deploy model-repl-3b-int8 route=/generate/async percent=40`
alice_oncall: Rolling to 40% now. Will watch error rates and latency.
emma_support: Response to AcmeCorp: "We've applied mitigations and routed some requests to fallback; you may see improved performance. Monitoring continues"
bob_sre: After downgrade and compaction, OOMs dropped to 0 in the last 8m.
alice_oncall: Closing immediate fire. Leaving incident open for postmortem. Action items: - bob_sre: investigate memory fragmentation root cause (due EOD) - dave_ml: evaluate kvcache eviction policy and safe cache sizes (due 48h) - carla_rte: run canary for model-repl-7b with new compaction flags (due 24h)
emma_support: Creating customer follow-up template for impacted customers.
alice_oncall: Adding note to PD incident: mitigations applied, traffic shifted, monitoring stabilizing. Will publish incident summary once RCA complete.
incident-bot: Incident PD-INVEST-4321 status: acknowledged -> mitigated.
carla_rte: Handing back on-call to primary. bob, you good to keep watch?
bob_sre: I'll monitor for next 2 hours, will escalate if regressions.
emma_support: Closing ticket with AcmeCorp as "monitoring" and will reopen if symptoms persist.
alice_oncall: Thanks team. Prep for postmortem doc: link draft /wiki/incidents/PD-4321-draft (add logs + timeline).
